title: 番外2项羽传
content_zh:
应某人之邀所写的项羽传，写得不好不要黑我，看我都是写在作品相关之中……
人死之前，一生经历的事情都会在眼前划过，项羽以前觉得这是一种玩笑话，而现在他正在经历这种事情。
秦始皇游会稽的时候，项羽年幼，但是他盯着那华盖之下威严的秦始皇，不由得生出一种，他日他将会取而代之。
相较于他叔父项梁的惊惧，当时年幼的项羽完全是一种发自本能的感受，并不知道自己为什么要说这句话，但是他知道总有一天他也会坐在那高高的座驾上，为万民所仰望。
后来他长大了一些，项梁开始消减教授他剑法的时间，开始教他读书，对于这种软绵绵听了让人想要睡觉的东西，他完全没有兴趣，他最喜欢的是那句，凭三尺剑，杀尽天下当杀之人，至于谁是当杀之人，自然是他项羽说了算。
抱着这样的想法，项羽剑学的很快，但是没什么用处，剑术始终是凡人之术，就算他天赋异禀，在被同乡百十个小伙伴打了之后，他觉得剑术真的没有什么用处，虽说那百十个小伙伴就剩下他一个人打完还能站起来，不过谁让他们骂他祖父。
一瘸一拐的走回自己家，身上的痛的要死，不过看着那群之前骂的狠的家伙趴在地上瑟瑟发抖，项羽感觉很爽，要是能将天下人都打成这样就好了，可惜剑术也就这样了，打了区区不到一百个自己就这样了。
回家之后，项梁像往常一样看着自己的侄子，最后长叹一句，准备回去弄点药草给自己的侄子泡泡，这种鼻青脸肿回来的情况，项梁已经见过好几次，他也不想过问，小孩子皮实点也该。
“我要学万人敌之术！”项羽跪在项梁面前说道，在这个时期他仍然觉得项梁是无所不能的。
“好！”项梁点了点头，开始教项羽兵法，也许是项羽真的很有天赋，不说是举一反三，至少项梁所讲的兵法他都能很轻松的理解。
当然项梁也没想过让项羽死记硬背，而项羽也只是大致了解，兵法这种东西靠的就是悟性。
那一段时间项羽生活的非常好，项梁也对于项羽也非常的满意，他有一个感觉，自家可能又要出一个千古名将了，项羽在兵法上的悟性非常好。
不过可惜天下已经统一，秦皇春秋鼎盛，作为楚国贵族之后，项梁不能忍受对于秦国卖命这种事，看着项羽不由得有些唏嘘。
也就在项梁的唏嘘声中，一颗陨石落了下来，“祖龙死而地分”为之这句话广为流传，不过秦始皇却将陨石收到了宫中，并没有多少对于谶纬之言的畏惧。
当然事实证明始皇不是没有畏惧，相反他也想永久的长存下去，一个叫徐福的仙人出现了。
也许在那件事之前，项羽并不相信这个世界上会有仙人存在，但是那件事之后他不得不承认，仙人确实是存在的，而且还不是一个，当然后来他也明白，仙人什么的也就是一巴掌就能抽死的弱鸡。
“徐福，将神石交出来！”某日项羽坐在一处偏僻的山坡上思考人生的时候，天空之中传来一声怒吼。
“呵呵呵，黄石，我要是不交呢？”一连串的娇笑，然后一身宫装的少女拿着一个罗盘虚立在天空之中。
“人皇不可永立，你当真要如此作为？”一身粗麻衣，提着一根鱼竿，穿着草鞋，带着斗笠，须发皆白的老头对着少女怒斥道。
“我不就是想炼一个丹吗？”徐福娇笑道，“我没有碍你的眼吧，你再闹，我不介意告诉陛下，有人调戏我这个正妃，怎么说我也是骊山神女~”

黄石头疼的看着面前这个女子，若非必要她还真不愿招惹徐福，毕竟对方的身份牵连太多，就如她所说她还在始皇面前当过骊山神女，也确实是正妃。
“将神石给我，或者停止炼丹，你这种做法根本是视万民于无物！”黄石头疼的说道，这天下能算得上的仙人的人也就那么几个了，而他就是之一，不得不管。
“我可不是偷国运哦~是陛下让我炼长生不老丹药的，奴家哪能违逆陛下的意志。”徐福一脸娇笑，但是眼中的寒光，还有手上的动作都说明了一个事实，那就是完全不拿对面的黄石公当人看。
那就没得说的，黄石公果断开打，一阵玩命之后，引天雷击碎了神石，然后神石崩碎的瞬间，逸散而出的强悍威势直接将黄石和徐福扫飞出去了近百里。
也就是那时一直趴在山坡上偷看，震惊的合不拢嘴的项羽在被狂暴爆炸仰面吹出去的时候，又被被神石核心砸中，然后鸡蛋大的神石核心差点将项羽噎死。
总之这件事就那么过去了，项羽意外的吞掉了一整个神石核心，虽说他完全不知道发生了什么，再加上本身就天赋异禀，并没有出现什么太诡异的事情，这件事就这么过去了。
之后项羽又开始学习兵法，练剑，然后身体各方面快速的提高，原本就处在发育期的他疯狂的成长了起来，很快他就发现，其实他是能打一百个的，不过由于自己还没有扭转观念，始终是觉得万人敌不是靠着剑能做到的，所以他也没有特意测试自己到底能打多少个。
至于黄石公在发现神石毁了，也就没去找徐福麻烦了，毕竟人家怎么说也是正妃，干掉神石就行了，当然也就黄石公这种好人才会如此随意，其他人不仔细研究一下神石才是怪事。
不过神石爆了之后，还没等黄石公养好伤就发现秦国的国运崩了，原本应该还有个二十几年活头的秦始皇就剩几年的活头了。
这个时候黄石公要不知道闯祸了才怪，很明显徐福将国运和千古一帝的命数外加神石熔铸在了一起，怪不得号称能练出让人不老不死的丹药。
赶紧找人收拾烂摊子，黄石公估摸着到时候秦国一崩，自己运数反噬肯定死翘翘，当即也不挣扎赶紧找一个传人，经过一番努力之后，终于找到了一个看的过眼的张良，一身所学给了对方之后，随便找了一个地方挖了一个坑开始等死。
content_en:
I wrote a biography of Xiang Yu at someone's invitation. If it's not well written, don't blame me. See, I wrote it in relation to the work...
Before a person dies, everything he has experienced in his life will flash before his eyes. Xiang Yu used to think this was a joke, but now he is experiencing this kind of thing.
When Qin Shihuang visited Kuaiji, Xiang Yu was young, but when he stared at the majestic Qin Shihuang under the canopy, he couldn't help but feel that he would replace him one day.
Compared with the fear of his uncle Xiang Liang, the young Xiang Yu felt completely instinctively at that time. He didn't know why he said this, but he knew that one day he would sit on that high car and be looked up to by all the people.
Later, when he grew older, Xiang Liang began to reduce the time spent teaching him swordsmanship and began to teach him reading. He had no interest in such soft things that made people want to sleep. What he liked the most was the sentence, with the three-foot sword, he can kill all the people in the world who deserve to be killed. As for who should be killed, Xiang Yu has the final say.
With this idea, Xiang Yu learned swordsmanship quickly, but it was of no use. Swordsmanship was always a mortal skill. Even if he was talented, after being beaten by hundreds of friends from the same village, he felt that swordsmanship was really useless. Although he was the only one of those hundreds of friends who could stand up after the beating, who told them to call his grandfather.
Limping back to his home, his body was in terrible pain, but seeing the group of guys he had scolded so harshly lying on the ground shivering, Xiang Yu felt very good. It would be great if he could beat everyone in the world like this. Unfortunately, swordsmanship can only be like this. He only beat a mere hundred people and ended up like this.
After returning home, Xiang Liang looked at his nephew as usual, and finally sighed, planning to go back and get some herbs to make bubbles for his nephew. Xiang Liang had seen this kind of situation with a bruised nose and swollen face several times, and he didn't want to ask about it. Children should be more solid-skinned.
"I want to learn the art of defeating thousands of people!" Xiang Yu said, kneeling in front of Xiang Liang. At this period, he still felt that Xiang Liang was omnipotent.
"Okay!" Xiang Liang nodded and began to teach Xiang Yu the art of war. Maybe Xiang Yu was really talented. Not to mention drawing inferences from one example, at least he could easily understand the art of war taught by Xiang Liang.
Of course, Xiang Liang never thought of asking Xiang Yu to memorize it by rote, and Xiang Yu only had a general understanding that the art of war relied on comprehension.
Xiang Yu's life was very good during that period, and Xiang Liang was also very satisfied with Xiang Yu. He had a feeling that his family might produce another famous general for the ages. Xiang Yu had a very good understanding of the art of war.
However, it is a pity that the world has been unified, and the Qin Emperor was at its peak in the Spring and Autumn Period. As a noble of the Chu State, Xiang Liang could not bear to sacrifice his life for the Qin State, and looked at Xiang Yu and couldn't help but sigh.
In the midst of Xiang Liang's sighs, a meteorite fell, and the saying "the ancestor dragon died and the earth was divided" was widely circulated. However, Qin Shihuang received the meteorite into the palace and did not have much fear of the prophecy.
Of course, it turns out that the First Emperor was not without fear. On the contrary, he also wanted to live forever. An immortal named Xu Fu appeared.
Maybe before that incident, Xiang Yu didn't believe that there would be immortals in this world, but after that incident, he had to admit that immortals did exist, and they were not just one. Of course, he later understood that immortals are just weaklings who can be beaten to death with one slap.
"Xu Fu, hand over the sacred stone!" One day when Xiang Yu was sitting on a remote hillside thinking about life, a roar came from the sky.
"Hehehe, Huang Shi, what if I don't pay you?" A series of cute smiles, and then a girl in palace clothes stood in the sky holding a compass.
"The human emperor cannot stand forever, do you really want to do this?" The old man with white beard and hair, dressed in coarse linen clothes, carrying a fishing rod, wearing straw sandals and a bamboo hat, was angry at the girl.scolded.
"Don't I just want to make an elixir?" Xu Fujiao said with a smile, "I'm not in your way. If you make trouble again, I don't mind telling your majesty that someone is teasing me, the royal concubine. After all, I am also the goddess of Lishan~"
Huang Shitou looked at the woman in front of her with pain. She really didn't want to provoke Xu Fu unless necessary. After all, the other party's identity was too implicated. As she said, she had been the goddess of Lishan Mountain in front of the First Emperor, and she was indeed the royal concubine.
"Give me the sacred stone, or stop refining alchemy. What you are doing is treating all people as nothing!" Huang Shitou said painfully. There are only a few people in the world who can be regarded as immortals, and he is one of them, so he has to take care of it.
"I'm not stealing the country's fortune~ His Majesty asked me to refine the elixir of immortality. How can I disobey His Majesty's will?" Xu Fu smiled sweetly, but the cold light in his eyes and the movements of his hands showed the fact that he did not regard Mr. Huang Shi as a human being at all.
There is nothing to say. Mr. Huang Shi fought decisively. After a desperate moment, the thunder from the sky shattered the sacred stone. Then the moment the sacred stone shattered, the powerful power that escaped directly swept Huang Shi and Xu Fu away for nearly a hundred miles.
At that time, Xiang Yu, who had been lying on the hillside to peek, was shocked from ear to ear. When he was blown away by the violent explosion, he was hit by the core of the sacred stone. Then the core of the sacred stone as big as an egg almost choked Xiang Yu to death.
In short, the incident just passed. Xiang Yu accidentally swallowed the entire core of the sacred stone. Although he had no idea what happened, and he was extremely talented, nothing too weird happened. The incident just passed.
After that, Xiang Yu began to learn the art of war and practice swordsmanship, and then all aspects of his body improved rapidly. He was already in the developmental stage and grew up crazily. Soon he discovered that he could actually fight a hundred people. However, because he had not changed his mind, he always felt that ten thousand enemies could not be defeated with a sword, so he did not deliberately test how many people he could fight.
As for Huang Shigong, when he found out that the sacred stone was destroyed, he didn't bother Xu Fu. After all, she was still a concubine, so she could just kill the sacred stone. Of course, only a good person like Huang Shigong would be so casual. It would be strange for others not to study the sacred stone carefully.
However, after the divine stone exploded, before Huang Shigong could recover from his injuries, he discovered that Qin's national destiny had collapsed. Qin Shihuang, who was supposed to have more than 20 years to live, only had a few years left to live.
It would be strange if Huang Shigong didn't know that he was in trouble at this time. It was obvious that Xu Fu had melted the fate of the country and the fate of the emperor through the ages together with the divine stone. No wonder he claimed to be able to develop a pill that would make people immortal.
He hurriedly found someone to clean up the mess. Huangshi estimated that if the Qin Kingdom collapsed, he would definitely die if his luck backfired. He immediately found a successor without any struggle. After a lot of hard work, he finally found Zhang Liang, who had seen it before. After giving him everything he had learned, he dug a hole in a random place and waited to die.
